topics.name: Agreeing and disagreeing
topics.summary: Birovning fikriga qo'shilganingizni yoki qo'shilmaganingizni muloyim tarzda aytish uchun. «that» dan keyin to'liq gap keladi.

usage.text: I agree that ... — «... degan fikrga qo'shilaman».

example.en: I agree that plastic is a big problem.
example.uz: Plastik katta muammo degan fikrga qo'shilaman.

usage.text: I don't agree that ... — «... degan fikrga qo'shilmayman».

example.en: I don't agree that glass is better than plastic.
example.uz: Shisha plastikdan yaxshi degan fikrga qo'shilmayman.

usage.text: I'm not sure that ... — «...ga ishonchim komil emas». Muloyim, yumshoq qo'shilmaslik.

example.en: I'm not sure that recycling solves everything.
example.uz: Qayta ishlash hamma muammoni hal qilishiga ishonchim komil emas.

usage.text: I wouldn't say that ... — «Men ... demagan bo'lardim». Yumshoq rad etish.

example.en: I wouldn't say that the new phone is bad, just expensive.
example.uz: Yangi telefonni yomon demagan bo'lardim, faqat qimmat.

example.en: I agree that it's too expensive.

structure.formula: I don't agree that / I'm not sure that + gap

example.en: I'm not sure that it will work.
I wouldn't say that it's easy.

topics.tip: «I am agree» — xato! «agree» fe'l: «I agree», «I don't agree».

topics.name: Making a complaint
topics.summary: Do'konda sotib olgan narsangiz buzuq chiqsa, sotuvchiga muloyim shikoyat qilish uchun.

usage.text: There's a problem / something wrong with ... — «...da muammo / nosozlik bor». Shikoyatni shu bilan boshlaysiz.

example.en: There's something wrong with this laptop.

usage.text: It doesn't work. / It has stopped working. — «Ishlamayapti / Ishlamay qoldi».

example.en: I bought it last week and it has stopped working.

usage.text: Can I have my money back, please? — «Pulimni qaytarib bera olasizmi?»

example.en: It's the second time. Can I have my money back, please?

usage.text: Can you exchange / repair it? — «Almashtirib / tuzatib bera olasizmi?»

example.en: Can you exchange it for a new one?

usage.text: Can I see / speak to the manager, please? — «Menejer bilan gaplashsam bo'ladimi?»

example.en: Can I speak to the manager, please?

structure.formula: There's a problem / something wrong + with + ot

example.en: There's a problem with my order.

structure.formula: It doesn't work. / It has stopped + V-ing
Can I have / see / speak to ...? · Can you exchange / repair it?

topics.tip: «There is a problem WITH ...» — predlog «with». «It has stopped work» emas — «stopped working» (-ing).

mistakes.wrong: There has a problem with it.
mistakes.right: There's (There is) a problem with it.
